name: entity-resolution
description: Guided build for entity resolution on customer, vendor and product master records already in Snowflake across multiple source systems. Standardizes records, generates candidate pairs with measured blocking, scores pairs with stored AI_EMBED vectors plus deterministic attribute features, adjudicates only the ambiguous middle band with AI_COMPLETE structured output (or snowflake-decision where the account has it), clusters matches into golden records with explicit cannot-link guards, deterministic survivorship and per-attribute provenance, and measures pairwise and cluster precision/recall against a labeled synthetic duplicate set. Ties duplicate vendor and record cleanup to OpEx and a single customer view to cross-sell revenue using customer-supplied inputs only.
